title: Phase 0: Wire-format contract design + freeze
description:
v0.1.0 blocker. Must land + freeze before any other phase implementation touches the seam.

Scope: (1) JSON envelope shape for `mdatron verify --json` (top-level: mdatron_wire_version, findings array, summary, pipeline_status). (2) Exit-code semantics (SE's three-state model): 0 = pipeline OK + may have findings; 1 = pipeline OK + at least one error-severity finding; 2 = pipeline failed; 3 = binary unavailable/version mismatch. (3) Global flag wiring: --quiet, --json, --log-level, --log-format, --dry-run. (4) Namespace-separation rule MDATRON-Exxxx <-> VSDD-Exxxx strictly separate; no proxy/intercept. (5) Methodology amendment: Phase 3 cluster-batched cold-session as default; inline requires operator-directive event.

Acceptance: wire envelope JSON schema documented in DESIGN-MDATRON.md; exit-code semantics documented and lint-checked; methodology.md amended.

Per docs/refactor/binary-first-plan.md Phase 0.
